level1.title: Liturgy of the Eucharist
level1.story: We bring bread and wine to the altar. The priest prays, and the bread and wine become Jesus' Body and Blood. We pray the Our Father, share a sign of peace, and receive Jesus in Holy Communion.
level1.heartIntro: Draw or write how you will take part in this part of the Mass next Sunday.
questions: What do the bread and wine become?
How can we get our hearts ready to receive Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for giving Yourself to us in the Eucharist. Make my heart ready for You. Amen.

level2.title: Liturgy of the Eucharist
level2.story: In the Liturgy of the Eucharist, we do what Jesus asked at the Last Supper. In the Presentation of the Gifts, bread and wine are brought to the altar, along with our gifts for the Church and the poor. In the Eucharistic Prayer, the priest prays the words of Jesus, and by the power of the Holy Spirit the bread and wine become the Body and Blood of Christ. We sing "Holy, Holy, Holy" and the Great Amen. Then we pray the Lord's Prayer together as God's children. We share the Sign of Peace with those around us. After the Lamb of God, we receive Jesus in Holy Communion (or make a spiritual communion and receive a blessing if we have not made our First Communion yet).
